idealSoil: Well-drained Sandy Loam to Clay Loam
hubs: Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Karnataka
descriptionEn: Premier winter pulse crop of India. Tolerant to residual moisture and improves soil nitrogen naturally.
imageAlt: Field of healthy chickpea chana crop bearing pods
harvestingIndicator: Plants turn yellow-brown and leaves start shedding; pods rattle on shaking.
introTipEn: Never irrigate at peak flowering stage as it causes flower drop. Give light irrigation during pod development.
efficiencyGain: 22% yield improvement with PSB + Rhizobium inoculation
micronutrientNote: Apply Sulphur 10 kg/acre and spray 2% Urea at early pod formation to boost protein filling.
stagnationAlert: Chickpea is highly sensitive to excess soil moisture; prevent any waterlogging.

fertilizerStages.quantityPerAcre: DAP 35 kg + MOP 15 kg + Sulphur 10 kg / acre

irrigation.frequencyEn: Only 1–2 light irrigations across entire season
irrigation.criticalStagesEn: Pre-flowering (40–45 DAS) and Pod Development (65–75 DAS)
irrigation.tipsEn: Do not irrigate during peak flowering to prevent excessive vegetative growth and flower drop.

pestsDiseases.symptomsEn: Defoliation in young crop and circular bored holes in developing pods with eaten seeds.
pestsDiseases.controlEn: Install 4 Pheromone traps/acre; spray Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG (80 g/acre) or Chlorantraniliprole (60 ml/acre).

pestsDiseases.symptomsEn: Drooping of petiole and rachis; internal vascular tissue turns brown-black.
pestsDiseases.controlEn: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride (10 g/kg) and avoid continuous chickpea cropping.

pestsDiseases.symptomsEn: Roots become black, brittle, and shred easily when pulled.
pestsDiseases.controlEn: Soil application of Trichoderma and avoid soil moisture stress at pod stage.

harvestSteps.textEn: Plants turn yellow-brown and leaves start shedding; pods rattle on shaking.
Harvest in morning hours with sickle to prevent pod shattering.
Dry harvested bundles in field for 4–6 days until thoroughly dry.
Thresh with pulse thresher. Store at 10% moisture. Expected yield: 7–11 Qtl/acre.
